concepts.name: Low garland
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent painted ornament for an ear-training website, a genuinely new design direction for a heading divider. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES only, not edit targets. Closely match their hand-painted late-medieval / early-Renaissance illuminated-manuscript acanthus: lobed lapis-blue and muted vermilion leaves, worn ochre gold, a few olive-green ivy leaves, fine dark-sepia outlines, fine ivory veins, matte tempera grain. Flat manuscript illumination, NOT glossy three-dimensional metal, not a vector icon, not filigree or rococo. Keep shapes legible at small size. NO letters, NO words, NO mockup interface. The empty title space will receive real live type later. True transparent background outside ornament. No shadows cast onto background. COMPOSITION: A very wide, low, continuous horizontal acanthus garland, approximately 1500 x 350 aspect ratio. A shallow gilded stem runs horizontally from a small finished gold cap on the far left to a small finished gold cap on the far right, along the upper third of the art. A rhythmic sequence of curled blue and red acanthus leaves hangs BELOW this stem. The heaviest blue leaf drop sits below the middle, with small red curls and olive ivy to either side, graceful balanced but not mechanically mirrored. The very top of the garland is a quiet nearly straight stem; nothing tall pokes upward where a heading will sit ABOVE the ornament. Everything is one connected bough. Entire ornament contained with a little transparent padding. NO wreath, no open center for text, no Y-shaped bifurcations, no two arms reaching around text. This is a painted lower border / swag underneath the title.

Closely match their hand-painted late-medieval / early-Renaissance illuminated-manuscript acanthus: lobed lapis-blue and muted vermilion leaves, worn ochre gold, a few olive-green ivy leaves, fine dark-sepia outlines, fine ivory veins, matte tempera grain. COMPOSITION: A broad horizontal blank parchment scroll label, approximately 1600 x 550 aspect ratio. The central 65% is a plain warm-ivory parchment strip, with almost straight thin ochre-gold top and bottom ink edges, perfectly ample unobstructed space for a title. This central strip has constant height and no decoration or folds in it, so it can extend horizontally. At the two ends the parchment curls back into convincing small folded tails. A dense small blue acanthus curl, red leaf, and olive ivy grow out of EACH OUTER fold, largely below and outside the writing panel. Keep foliage confined to the outermost 20% each end. The writing panel is about the middle 45% of the art height. Polished understated manuscript banderole, supple parchment but flat painted manuscript perspective. No surrounding frame or wreath, no Y branches, no elaborate top crown. Complete visible ends, transparent outside the scroll. Absolutely blank writing panel.
